title: Dialogue Delivery Review
summary: Review dialogue level, programme relationship, coverage, and range alongside programme structure.
descriptionMarkdown: Review spoken delivery and its relationship to the full programme in one workspace. A large channel-aware Waveform preserves dialogue structure and routing context, while linked Momentary and Short-term loudness history sits beside Dialogue Loudness, LDR, Dialogue Coverage, Dialogue Range, Integrated Loudness, and True Peak. Stereo and 5.1 previews use PLVS's dialogue benchmark to show antiphase, centre, off-centre, and surround speech handling.
